text:
Maggie G.: Proposal: run a short UX lab to compare three flows for the pricing calculator embed: inline open, slide-in modal, and gated advanced estimator. 20-25m workshop next Thu.
Dario P.: ok. primary metric = demo bookings from high-fit leads; secondary = calc starts and email captures.
Simeon K.: suggestion: also measure friction (time-to-first-interaction) and drop-offs by step. we can add a tiny pixel to measure.
Elaine R.: FAQ test matrix: Variant 1 = benefits-first bullets; Variant 2 = numbers-first (latency & SLA); Variant 3 = micro-answers for mobile. keep each <=3 bullets.
Tara M.: routing idea: add lead_funnel_score = domain_signal + company_size_bucket + token_estimate. if score>=65 => tag:priority_sdr and auto-enqueue. ops-bot: can you create a rule?
ops-bot: created event "pricing-uxlab-3201234567" and rule "calc_lead_scoring" (domain+size+tokens) => tag:priority_sdr when score>=65.
Maggie G.: gating experiment: gate only advanced estimator behind email + company_size OR require email verification flag. we A/B gate on/off.
Dario P.: careful with verification friction. maybe gate only on repeat visits or when user opts for "advanced".
Simeon K.: embed examples for devs: lightweight iframe and script loader. use UTM pricing-uxlab-3201234567 and variant param.
Simeon K.: snippet 1 (iframe):
```
<iframe src="https://embed.redwood.ai/pricing-calc?utm=pricing-uxlab-3201234567&variant=inline" width="100%" height="540"></iframe>
```
Simeon K.: snippet 2 (script for modal):
```
<script src="https://cdn.redwood.ai/pricing-widget.js" data-variant="modal" data-utm="pricing-uxlab-3201234567"></script>
```
Elaine R.: copy starters for FAQ bullets: Committed (benefits-first): "Predictable monthly bill", "Reserved GPU pools", "SLA & priority support". Metered (benefits-first): "Pay per token", "Burst autoscale", "Batching & quantization tips".
Tara M.: registration form: work email, company size bucket, estimated monthly tokens, short use case (optional). keep <45s.
Dario P.: tracking: UTM + variant=inline|modal|gated. record variant in SDR CSV. SDR fields = email, company, size_bucket, token_est, utm_variant, lead_tags, lead_funnel_score.
Maggie G.: timeline: copy & embed ready Tue, dev drops snippets Wed, soft launch Thu AM, one reminder Thu noon, wrap and analyze Fri.
Elaine R.: I'll make a one-paragraph benchmark blurb for the slide: "Sample workloads show that switching to optimized batching and the right model family lowered per-token spend by ~30% while keeping tail latency inside our SLO for common throughput mixes. Use the calculator to model your tradeoff."
Tara M.: success thresholds: booked demos >=7% of attendees, calc starts +14% vs baseline, gated leads average lead_funnel_score +18% vs inline.
Maggie G.: who can QA copy Tue morning in #marketing-summaries? Elaine + Tara pairing?
Elaine R.: will do. Tara M.: I can help. Maggie G.: perfect. ops-bot: please tag this thread with event id and post the routing rule summary to #ops-alerts.
ops-bot: posted summary to #ops-alerts and attached rule "calc_lead_scoring".
Maggie G.: thanks everyone :rocket:
